settlement_source: Source Agency is Kalshi itself (contract terms); series lists 'For example, Google Finance' only. Observed expiration_value equals the official S&P 500 close to the cent (Oct 23: 7623.68; Oct 26: 7676.77).
settlement_variable: H1600 markets: official S&P 500 end-of-day closing level (price index); YES iff close >= floor_strike (strikes X.9999, greater_or_equal). Intraday H1000/H1500 markets use the index print at that minute. Revisions after expiration ignored; no data -> most recent prior value.
timezone: ET; close_time 20:00Z under EDT (21:00Z after Nov 1 — verify). Opens at prior close.
tie_handling: Close published to 2 dp vs X.9999 strike -> no ties; subtitle '7,745.0099 or above' is an artifact; effective threshold >= integer strike.
rounding: None stated; index 2 dp; expiration_value 4 dp.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Trading closes 16:00:00 ET = closing auction instant; final close finalized ~16:00-16:15 ET; Kalshi settles H1600 ~23:01Z (3 h later) on the final official close. Intraday markets settle ~2 min after close.
early_close_or_void_clauses: No void: no data -> most recent prior value (holiday/outage settles on stale level); half-day behaviour unspecified; can_close_early true; Market Outcome Review 6.3(c)/7.1.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title '4pm' tick vs rules 'end-of-day' official close (can differ by 1-5 points via the closing auction)
